title: Technical Recruiter - Contractor (India)
description:
**About Fortanix:**


In today's world, where data spreads across various clouds and devices, traditional security measures aren't enough. Businesses need a dynamic approach to defend against constant cyber threats and ensure agile data security. Fortanix leads the way in data\-centric cybersecurity for hybrid multicloud environments, using advanced cryptography, encryption, and confidential AI solutions.


As data breaches become more frequent and traditional defenses fall short, we focus on data exposure management to keep your information safe. Our unified data security platform addresses vulnerabilities in hybrid multicloud environments, defends against threats, and makes it easier to discover, assess, and fix data exposure risks. Whether implementing a Zero Trust model or preparing for the post\-quantum computing era, we help businesses worldwide protect their most sensitive data, wherever it is.


Our commitment to solving the world’s toughest data security challenges has earned Fortanix multiple Cybersecurity Excellence and Innovation Awards, as well as recognition from industry giants such as NVIDIA, Microsoft, Intel, ServiceNow, and Snowflake.


Our team includes industry leaders and cryptography experts, creating a culture of trust, innovation and collaboration where every voice is valued. Recognized as a Great Place to Work, we're looking for passionate individuals to help us shape the future of data security and work towards a safer digital future.

 **Why work with us?**


We're seeking passionate people to work with us to change the very idea of how people use cloud computing. We take pride in making Fortanix a great place to work. Coworkers recognize that great ideas can come from anyone, and everyone is encouraged to jump in, contribute, and ask questions. In tackling the hardest problems, we believe that working together will produce better solutions.

 **Requirements**  

  

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Technical Recruiter for this contractor role to support hiring across technical functions. This role is responsible for managing the full recruitment lifecycle—from sourcing and screening candidates through offer acceptance—while partnering closely with hiring managers to deliver an exceptional candidate experience.


The ideal candidate is proactive, highly organized, and has a proven track record recruiting for fast\-paced technology companies.


Responsibilities* Manage full\-cycle recruiting for multiple open positions.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs and develop recruiting strategies.
* Source and engage passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, and other sourcing channels.
* Screen candidates to assess technical qualifications, experience, and overall fit.
* Coordinate interviews and provide timely communication throughout the hiring process.
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
* Maintain accurate candidate records within the applicant tracking system.
* Provide market insights, hiring trends, and recommendations to improve recruiting effectiveness.


Qualifications* 5\+ years of full\-cycle recruiting experience, preferably within a high\-growth technology company.
* Demonstrated success recruiting software engineers and other technical talent.
* Strong sourcing skills with experience identifying and engaging passive candidates.
* Experience partnering directly with hiring managers and influencing hiring decisions.
* Excellent communication and organizational skills.
* Experience using applicant tracking systems and LinkedIn Recruiter.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of candidate experience.


Preferred Qualifications* Experience recruiting for high level engineer roles for cybersecurity or enterprise software companies.
* Existing network of senior and staff\-level software engineers in the Rust ecosystem
* Experience recruiting globally across multiple regions.
* Familiarity with engineering roles involving Rust, cloud, Kubernetes, Linux, DevOps, infrastructure, security, or systems software.


Success in this Role* Consistently delivers qualified candidates quickly.
* Builds strong relationships with hiring managers and candidates.
* Operates independently with minimal oversight.
* Maintains a high standard of quality while managing multiple searches simultaneously.

  

**Benefits**  

* Hybrid Work Model
* 12 Annual Leaves \& 12 Casual/Sick Leaves
* 8 Public Holidays \+ 2 Floating Holiday
* Comprehensive Medical and Dental Insurance Coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
* Group Life Insurance
* Personal Accident Insurance
* Internet Reimbursement
* Employee Stock Options
* Onsite Snacks, Lunches, and Dinners Provided
* Quarterly Beer Bashes \& Year\-End Celebrations

*Fortanix is an equal opportunity employer that celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace with equal opportunity for all applicants and teammates. Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other status. If you’re interested in working in a fast growing, exciting working environment – we encourage you to apply!*

title: HR Recruiter
description:
We are looking for a qualified and experienced HR Recruiter \& Generalist to join our human resources team.

As an HR Recruiter, you will be responsible for finding, attracting, and hiring the best talent for our organization. You will work closely with hiring managers to understand their staffing needs and design effective recruitment strategies. You will also ensure a positive candidate experience and promote our employer brand.

As an HR generalist you will be responsible to support HR department in ensuring smooth and efficient business operations. The human resources generalist will have both administrative and strategic responsibilities, and will help with important functions such as staffing, training and development, and compensation and benefits.

**Experience** : 1 \- 3 Yrs

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with hiring managers to define job requirements and create job postings
* Source and screen candidates using various online channels, such as job boards, social media, and professional networks
* Conduct phone, video, and in\-person interviews and assess candidates' skills and fit
* Coordinate hiring activities, such as scheduling interviews, conducting reference checks, and making job offers
* Maintain a database of potential candidates and track recruitment metrics
* Build and maintain relationships with candidates, employees, and external partners
* Stay updated on the latest trends and best practices in recruitment

**Mandatory Requirements**:

* Any Bachelor's degree
* At least 1 years of proven experience as an HR Recruiter (IT) in a fast\-paced environment
* Knowledge of various recruitment methods and tools, such as applicant tracking systems, resume databases, and sourcing techniques
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with different teams
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Attention to detail and quality
* Familiarity with labour laws and regulations

If you are interested in this position, please send your resume and cover letter to hr@agileidc.com. We look forward to hearing from you

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: Up to ₹300,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Current CTC
* Expected CTC
* How many years of experience do you have in IT Recruitment ?
* When is the earliest date you can join if offered ?

Experience:

* total work: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
**Career Area:**


Human Resources**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.


Job Description### **Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to develop and execute recruitment strategies aligned with organizational goals and workforce plans.
* Provide market intelligence, talent insights, and data\-driven recommendations to support hiring decisions.
* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, assessment coordination, reference checks, offer negotiation, and onboarding support.
* Utilize Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), Candidate Relationship Management (CRM) platforms, and advanced sourcing tools to identify and engage top talent.
* Build and maintain robust talent pipelines to support current and future hiring needs.
* Implement sourcing strategies focused on attracting diverse and high\-quality talent while optimizing time\-to\-fill and cost\-per\-hire metrics.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience through proactive communication and effective stakeholder management.
* Monitor recruitment metrics and leverage workforce analytics to improve hiring outcomes and process efficiencies.
* Promote employer branding initiatives and represent the organization positively in the talent marketplace.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, employment legislation, and recruitment best practices.

**Skill Descriptors**

### **Relationship Management**

**Knowledge of relationship management techniques and the ability to establish and maintain productive relationships with business leaders, candidates, vendors, and peers.**

* Influences hiring managers and business leaders through data\-driven recommendations.
* Builds and maintains long\-term partnerships with key stakeholders and external vendors.

### **Customer/Market Focus**

**Understanding of evolving market trends and the ability to respond to customer and business needs in a manner that consistently adds value.**

* Identifies expressed and unexpressed business talent needs.
* Aligns recruiting strategies to critical business objectives.

### **Recruitment Channel Management**

**Knowledge of selecting, implementing, and managing recruitment channels to support talent acquisition objectives.**

* Utilizes multiple recruitment channels to attract top talent.
* Identifies and manages cost\-effective sourcing partners and recruitment vendors.

### **Candidate Screening**

**Knowledge of effective candidate assessment and screening methodologies.**

* Screens candidates for professional, technical, and leadership roles.
* Ensures compliance with HR policies and recruitment standards throughout the screening process.

### **Candidate Sourcing**

**Knowledge of sourcing techniques, methods, and tools to attract top talent.**

* Develops and executes multi\-channel sourcing strategies.
* Advises business leaders on talent availability and sourcing approaches.
* Benchmarks sourcing strategies against industry best practices.

### **Staffing and Recruiting**

**Knowledge of staffing strategies, recruiting processes, and talent acquisition best practices.**

* Manages complex recruitment assignments across multiple business functions.
* Consults with stakeholders on workforce planning, recruitment strategies, and talent availability.

### **Workforce Analytics**

**Knowledge of HR metrics, workforce trends, and reporting methodologies that support informed business decisions.**

* Analyzes recruitment and workforce data to identify trends and opportunities.
* Generates reports and dashboards to support leadership decision\-making.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **At minimal 4 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruiting, or Human Resources.**
* Proven experience managing end\-to\-end recruitment for technical, professional hiring.
* Strong stakeholder management and consulting skills.
* Experience using ATS, CRM platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter, and other sourcing technologies.
* Strong analytical, communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced, high\-volume recruitment environment preferred.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.
Relocation is available for this position.**Posting Dates:**


September 16, 2026 \- September 17, 2026
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: Member of Technical Staff - III, Technical Support
description:
Mavenir is building the future of networks and pioneering advanced technology, focusing on the vision of a single, software\-based automated network that runs on any cloud. As the industry's only end\-to\-end, cloud\-native network software provider, Mavenir is transforming the way the world connects, accelerating software network transformation for 250\+ Communications Service Providers in over 120 countries, which serve more than 50% of the world’s subscribers.

**Role Summary**


Specializes in providing assistance to field engineers, technicians, and product support in diagnosing, troubleshooting, repairing and debugging complex systems (e.g., electro/mechanical equipment, computer, complex software, or networked and wireless systems).**Key Responsibilities**


Provide technical support for RAN , PACO and IMS products of Mavenir.


Monitor Packet Core network elements to ensure high availability, performance, and reliability  

Proactively identify and resolve issues affecting data, voice (VoLTE), and signaling traffic  

Perform 24×7 L2/L3 operational support as per shift or on\-call requirements  

Troubleshoot signaling and user\-plane issues involving:  

GTP\-C / GTP\-U ,Diameter, SIP,HTTP/2 (5G SBA interfaces)  

Analyze interfaces such as S1, S5/S8, N2, N3, N4, N6, N11, Gy/Gx  

Use protocol analyzers and traces to diagnose complex network problems

**Job Requirements**


10\+ yrs of overall exp.. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Science, or equivalent)  

Relevant telecom certifications (preferred but not mandatory):


3GPP / LTE / 5G Core certifications


Strong understanding of LTE / EPC architecture, including:  

MME, SGW, PGW, HSS, PCRF


Working knowledge of 5G Core architecture, including:  

AMF, SMF, UPF, UDM, AUSF, PCF, NRF


Hands\-on experience supporting data, signaling, and control plane issues

**Accessibility**


Mavenir is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you require any assistance, please state in your application or contact your recruiter.


Mavenir is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and welcomes qualified applicants from around the world, regardless of their ethnicity, gender, religion, nationality, age, disability, or other legally protected status.
